chunks: On this world and the next. And they ask you about the orphans. Tell them: "Improving their lot is much better; and if you take interest in their affairs, they are your brethren; and God is aware who are corrupt and who are honest; and if He had pleased He could surely have imposed on you hardship, for God is all-powerful and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What is the preferred way to handle an orphan's property according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the principle of 'Islah' (rectification) as the primary duty of guardians, emphasizing that active management and protection of orphan assets are superior to passive co-mingling. It underscores divine omniscience in distinguishing between genuine care and exploitation, while the phrase 'law sha'a Allahu la a'natkum' (if God had willed, He would have made it difficult) serves as a comfort to guardians, indicating that the burden of care is manageable and not an impossible trial.
